# Is your red GitHub Actions check even real?

> Paste the JSON from a GitHub Actions run and find out in one click whether a red check is a real failure or GitHub silently never assigned it a runner. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
